mapper.select: SELECT id, resource_uuid, canonical_key, btih, btmh, version_type, name, piece_length, total_bytes, file_count, private_flag, metadata_key, metadata_status, created_at, updated_at FROM magnet_v2_resource WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.resource_uuid, r.canonical_key, r.btih, r.btmh, r.version_type, r.name, r.piece_length, r.total_bytes, r.file_count, r.private_flag, r.metadata_key, r.metadata_status, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM magnet_v2_resource r JOIN magnet_v2_resource_hash_alias a ON a.resource_id = r.id WHERE a.hash_type = #{hashType} AND a.hash_bytes = #{hashBytes} AND r.metadata_status = 'READY' LIMIT 1
